name: kise-backend
description: Kise - personal expense tracker API (Ethiopian & Gregorian calendars)

KISE_SECRET_KEY.description: Signing key for access tokens. Must be a long random string.

KISE_CORS_ORIGINS.description: JSON list of allowed CORS origins. Narrow this to the app's real origins.

KISE_APP_STORE_URL.description: Landing page App Store link; leave empty until a build is published.

KISE_PLAY_STORE_URL.description: Landing page Play Store link; leave empty until a build is published.

KISE_APP_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Direct download link (APK, TestFlight, GitHub release).
